questions.question_text: Provide a detailed summary (80-100 words) of 'The Winner', highlighting the character actions and moral outcome.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Georgia Heard evokes rich sensory details: the visual shift from 'blue dark' to pitch black, the tactile feeling of 'cold grass aching feet', and the acoustic rhythm of breathless panting. She uses personification effectively when tree shadows 'creep close' and 'Night wins!'. Instead of a sports team winning, Night personified as an unstoppable competitor halts play, showing nature's ultimate control.
